name: @qu/webrtc
description: WebRTC as an app-level feature, not a network transport: WebRTCTransport is a general implementation of @qu/sync's Transport interface (RTCDataChannel) usable behind any SyncEngine, and WebRTCAdapter exposes it as an ordinary QuMount with both idioms Qu apps already know - put/get/getAll/getChildren (state, backed by a pluggable local adapter) and on/emit (event/listener, pass-through like @qu/core's VolatileAdapter). Signaling (SDP/ICE) is deliberately NOT this package's concern - see @qu/services' WebRtcSignalService, which carries it over the existing relay-backed sync stack instead of inventing a new one. Browser-only (RTCPeerConnection has no realistic Node implementation) - deliberately no shared '.' entry point, same reasoning as @qu/runtime's own package.json.
